title.zh: 眼睛与眼镜 · 为什么近视要戴凹透镜
title.en: The Eye and Glasses · Why Short-Sightedness Needs a Concave Lens

desc.zh: 眼睛是一台自带变焦的照相机：晶状体把光聚在视网膜上；聚到视网膜前面就是近视，凹透镜把焦点推回去。
desc.en: The eye is a camera with a built-in zoom: the lens focuses light on the retina; when focus lands in front of it you are short-sighted and a concave lens pushes it back.
